title: Beach as a child in 2007
content: I have always remembered nearly every detail of every dream in vivid detail, with my dreams always seeming more like memories than what I hear dreams being like to others. Well, when I was 11 (back in 2007) I had this one really bizarre dream that I could only ever remember flashes of, as opposed to remembering the entire thing as I normally would. In the dream, I remembered going to the beach in my Uncles van but I was alone in the van as it was driving, the seat was empty. next thing I know, I'm at the beach feeling like I was just "waking up", vision blurry, thoughts slow and groggy, and as I'm looking around I see kids, as far as the eye can see. Just a bunch of random kids all around my age, give or take a few years. There was nobody else, no adults, no animals or birds, just thousands and thousands of us kids. I remember trying to figure out what was going on, I remember talking to quite a few of the kids, introducing ourselves and stuff, I remember one of the kids, a young blonde girl, having a seizure. Above all else though, the one thing I remember most clearly is that there was something wrong with the water. No idea if it was the water itself, something that was in the water, or what, just that something was horribly horribly wrong with the water. Well, once waking up from this dream I went on with life, eventually forgetting it, until one day when I was 19 my GF at the time and I started talking about weird dreams we've had in the past, and she brought up this weird beach dream. Turns out, we both had the exact same dream. At the exact same time. We had even met each other in the dream, and remember the same girl having a seizure, the same vague-yet-terrifying "something's wrong with the water", and even remember feeling like we were "waking up" when we appeared on the beach. to this day, I have no idea what the hell it means, or what actually happened that night. I have since met a few other people I knew from the beach dream but never mentioned the dream to them, both afraid that they had the dream as well and what it would mean if they did, and also afraid that they hadn't and would just think me crazy. There are more details I could include, but I won't, as I am actually curious whether or not anyone else had a similar dream, and if any details you say will match as well.
